title: Full-generator Kubo-Mori pairing cancellation for actual finite Q3 D and delta-D
question: For the actual finite Q3 history D(t), can the full generator pairing identity <delta^2 D,D>_KM + <delta D,delta D>_KM = 0 provide a genuine cancellation-aware replacement for isolating the divergent V'f' term?
method: Build the exact finite Q3 Hamiltonian with oscillator dimension three on the two-site edge and four-site square, using the registered onsite and bond fixture. Replace only bond coordinates by the smooth cosine cutoff and define W_L=H-H_L.

For beta in {0.5,1,2}, time in {0.05,0.1}, cutoff radius in {0.5,1,2}, and both signs, generate the actual history D_sigma(t)=U_(H+sigma W_L)(t) A_2 U_(H+sigma W_L)(t)^* - U_H(t) A_2 U_H(t)^* and the exact finite generators delta_H(D)=i[H,D]/hbar and delta_H^2(D).

Diagonalize H and evaluate the two-sided Kubo-Mori inner product with the logarithmic-mean diagonal limit. Check the full-generator identity <delta_H^2 D,D>_KM + <delta_H D,delta_H D>_KM=0 and positivity of D, delta-D, and delta-squared-D forms in every row.

Rebuild the evolution independently in the H eigenbasis, compare summary rows within the declared tolerance, and compile Lean R310 for the exact rational spectral coefficients and cancellation identity.
finding: Primary 316/316, independent 240/240, integrated 12/12, and Lean R310 PASS over 72 actual history rows. The complete finite generator pairing identity holds with cancellation errors at or below 1.1e-19 in the primary lane, and the independent eigenbasis lane agrees within the 1e-8 numerical tolerance. The Kubo-Mori delta-D maximum grows from the two-site edge to the four-site square by ratios 2.4036 (beta=0.5), 2.7175 (beta=1), and 3.1214 (beta=2). This validates a cancellation-aware finite identity but leaves source/volume/beta-uniform direct D/delta-D control unresolved.
decision_reason: The finite audit replaces the invalid termwise V'f' multiplier estimate by the exact full-generator skew-adjoint pairing, while retaining the actual D and delta-D histories rather than a proxy derivative. It closes a reusable finite lemma and a finite volume-growth diagnostic. The two volumes do not establish an asymptotic lower bound or a general no-go, and the identity alone gives no uniform constant, modular-domain theorem, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result.
closed: actual finite Q3 D(t) and delta-D histories on two-site and square graphs
finite Kubo-Mori positivity and delta-squared rows
finite volume-growth diagnostic for the state-weighted delta-D norm
independent reproduction and Lean R310 cross-check
open: analytic source/volume/beta-uniform direct D and delta-D Cauchy estimate
all-shape exhaustion independence and product/core density
beta-independent common alpha and group law
Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: The i[H,·]/hbar convention is used for both delta and delta-squared, and the spectral lane reproduces the same sign coefficient.
No termwise V'f' cancellation is asserted; delta-squared is paired as a complete generator so kinetic and potential pieces remain together.
The logarithmic-mean diagonal limit is used at equal probabilities and each beta row is formed from the actual H spectrum.
D and delta-D are produced from H and H+sigma W_L, not from the one-site h' proxy used in EXP-001139.
Only volumes two and four are sampled; the ratios are diagnostics, not asymptotic monotonicity or a no-go theorem.
Uniform direct Cauchy, modular domain, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A finite actual-Q3 two-orientation D/delta-D history audit and a full-generator Kubo-Mori cancellation identity in each finite H eigenbasis.
qft_interface.open: A source/volume/beta-uniform direct-Cauchy theorem, modular domain transfer, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This replaces only the invalid termwise-force estimate by a finite full-generator pairing; it is not a common infinite-volume dynamics theorem.

next_action: Extend the same full-generator pairing to the registered six-site 2x3 graph and a structured increasing cutoff/source family. Derive an analytic bound for the Kubo-Mori delta-D norm or, if the finite growth persists with a certified lower-bound family, record only that route-specific obstruction before moving to the exact common-core carrier.
boundary: This is a finite actual-Q3 full-generator Kubo-Mori pairing audit over two graphs, three beta values, three cutoffs, two times and both orientations. It is not a source/volume-uniform D/delta-D theorem, a common infinite-volume dynamics result, a full QFT reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result.
no_overclaim: The finite full-generator cancellation identity is valid and reusable, but it neither proves a uniform bound nor closes any common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A gate.
